name: create_dynamic_mesh
purpose: Allocate a named transient UDynamicMesh working object — opens the entire GeometryScript pipeline to the agent.
cooked: works — transient objects, no asset I/O
hazards: MaxPoolSize failsafe trip permanently leaks pre-trip meshes (ReturnMesh ensure fails)
Bridge must enforce its own live-handle cap (~256); never rely on the CVar failsafe
Pool must be rooted (AddToRoot) or GC collects pooled meshes; must NOT be undoable

name: list_dynamic_meshes
purpose: Enumerate live mesh handles with numeric state — the leak detector and session inspector.
cooked: works

name: release_dynamic_mesh
purpose: Return a mesh (or all meshes) to the pool — explicit lifetime end, prevents GC-rooted leaks.
cooked: works
hazards: ReturnMesh silently no-ops (failed ensure) for untracked meshes after a failsafe trip
Only clean recovery after failsafe trip is all=true (FreeAllMeshes + map clear)

name: mesh_op
purpose: Single dispatcher applying one allowlisted GeometryScript operation to a named mesh — ~80 engine functions via one endpoint.
engineApi: UGeometryScriptLibrary_* (AppendBox MeshPrimitiveFunctions.h:161-173; ApplyMeshBoolean MeshBooleanFunctions.h:132-140; et al.)
cooked: works — pure transient-mesh compute, no asset access
hazards: Remesh/voxel ops synchronous, seconds on big meshes — enforce per-op input-size cap (2M tris)
ApplyUniformRemesh header warns expensive and non-deterministic
Transacting would push huge FDynamicMesh3 snapshots into the undo buffer

name: mesh_query
purpose: Numeric inspection of a pooled mesh — the verification story for every mesh_op (agent cannot see the viewport).
cooked: works

name: commit_dynamic_mesh
purpose: Write a pooled mesh's geometry into a UStaticMesh asset LOD — bridge from procedural compute to real, placeable assets.
cooked: refuses — cooked UStaticMesh has no MeshDescription/SourceModel to write
hazards: Self-transacts (bEmitTransaction=true, cpp :257-374) — blanket transaction would double-transact
PostEditChange kicks an async rebuild — poll asset_compile_status before verifying

name: copy_from_static_mesh
purpose: Load an existing StaticMesh (or SkeletalMesh) LOD into a pooled dynamic mesh for measurement or derivation.
cooked: degraded — render_data works only via direct-converter guard path; source_mesh refuses
hazards: Stock wrapper asserts (crash) on cooked meshes: reads GetSourceModel(LOD) BuildScale in editor builds
Pre-check GetNumSourceModels > LOD; else call FStaticMeshLODResourcesToDynamicMesh::Convert directly

name: create_static_mesh_asset
purpose: Create a brand-new UStaticMesh asset from a pooled mesh — the mod-content authoring path, no cooked-asset restriction.
cooked: works — creates NEW loose assets; does not touch cooked content
hazards: Asset is created+registered but NOT saved to disk despite header doc — pair with save_package

name: set_static_mesh_collision_from_mesh
purpose: Generate simple collision (boxes/spheres/capsules/convex/swept hulls) for a StaticMesh asset from any pooled mesh.
cooked: refuses — UBodySetup rebuild needs editor data
prevents: spawned/committed meshes unusable in PIE for lack of collision
hazards: Self-transacts (bEmitTransaction=true)
Convex decomposition synchronous — cap input tri count, error above cap

name: mesh_asset_info
purpose: One read-only report of a StaticMesh asset's numeric state — LODs, verts, UV channels, collision counts, Nanite, sockets.
cooked: degraded — render-data counts work; Nanite settings return defaults; response flags cooked:true
hazards: CheckIfInEditorAndPIE makes getters silently return zeros during PIE — detect PIE and error

name: set_static_mesh_lods
purpose: Generate reduction LOD chain for a StaticMesh with per-LOD triangle percentages and screen sizes.
cooked: refuses — reduction needs source MeshDescription, stripped from cooked assets
hazards: Triggers full async mesh build — do not wrap in blanket transaction (giant undo snapshots)
Refuses during PIE (CheckIfInEditorAndPIE returns false) — error should say stop_pie

name: set_lod_build_settings
purpose: Set per-LOD build options — lightmap UV generation, normals/tangents recompute, remove degenerates — then rebuild.
cooked: refuses — build settings live on FStaticMeshSourceModel, editor-only
hazards: Refuses during PIE (CheckIfInEditorAndPIE)

name: add_simple_collision
purpose: Add primitive simple-collision shapes (box/sphere/capsule/kDOP) to a StaticMesh — replicates Collision > Add Simplified Collision.
cooked: refuses — UBodySetup rebuild requires editor path
hazards: Refuses during PIE (CheckIfInEditorAndPIE)

name: set_convex_collision
purpose: Auto-convex decomposition collision (V-HACD) for one or many StaticMeshes — the quality option beyond primitives.
cooked: refuses
hazards: Blocks game thread in WaitFor(33ms) loop pumping an FScopedSlowTask progress dialog
Closes any open static-mesh editor tab on the assets and reopens it afterwards
Input-size cap mandatory (refuse >500k tris per mesh)
Refuses during PIE (CheckIfInEditorAndPIE)

name: set_nanite_settings
purpose: Enable/disable/tune Nanite on a StaticMesh asset (with build trigger) — per-asset Nanite control not reachable via set_property.
cooked: refuses — no source data to build Nanite from; works on loose/new assets
hazards: bApplyChanges=true triggers full (potentially long) async Nanite build
Refuses during PIE (CheckIfInEditorAndPIE)

name: static_mesh_sockets
purpose: List/create/remove sockets on a StaticMesh asset (attachment points for spawn logic).
cooked: works — sockets are runtime data; edits in-memory only on cooked, persistent only on loose assets

name: build_static_mesh
purpose: Explicit renderable-data rebuild after property-level edits — the missing apply step; plus a global async-compile poll endpoint.
cooked: refuses — needs source model
hazards: Passing OutErrors forces SYNCHRONOUS build (multi-second game-thread stall) — never pass it
Build() must not run inside a transaction (reregisters components, swaps render data)

name: generate_uv_channel
purpose: Asset-level UV projection (planar/cylindrical/box) plus UV channel add/insert/remove on a StaticMesh LOD.
cooked: refuses — writes MeshDescription
hazards: Functions return false during PIE (CheckIfInEditorAndPIE) — detect PIE and error

name: skeletal_mesh_info
purpose: Read-only numeric report on a SkeletalMesh asset — LODs, verts/sections, morph targets, sockets. First skeletal visibility.
cooked: degraded — counts, morph names, sockets work; morph deltas may be stripped (flag, don't error)
hazards: Subsystem getters silently return zeros during PIE — detect PIE and error
GetMorphTargets() accessor synchronously waits if mesh is mid-async-compilation

name: skeletal_mesh_sockets
purpose: Create/rename/remove sockets on a SkeletalMesh asset (attach points for props/weapons — direct DDS2 modding use).
cooked: works — edits in-memory only on cooked; persistent save only for loose assets
hazards: No exported RemoveSocket; Sockets UPROPERTY is private — reflection edit + RebuildSocketMap only
AddSocket sits inside #if WITH_EDITOR (guard call sites)
NumSockets() counts mesh AND skeleton sockets — use reflected array length for delta checks

name: create_physics_asset
purpose: Generate a UPhysicsAsset for a SkeletalMesh as if created through FBX import — one call, no UI.
cooked: works — with caveat; back-reference into cooked source mesh won't persist
hazards: Destination is derived <SkelMeshPackage>_PhysicsAsset — no path parameter; return derived path
Refuses during PIE (CheckIfInEditorAndPIE)

name: regenerate_skeletal_lods
purpose: (Re)generate a skeletal mesh LOD chain via the built-in reducer.
cooked: refuses — reduction needs source data
hazards: FLODUtilities::RegenerateLOD runs synchronously on game thread — cap input size or document stall
Returns false during PIE (CheckIfInEditorAndPIE)

name: merge_static_mesh_actors
purpose: Merge multiple placed StaticMeshComponents into ONE new StaticMesh asset — the editor Merge Actors tool, headless.
cooked: works — cooked sources readable via render-data path; output is a NEW loose asset
hazards: Synchronous, potentially seconds of work — cap component count at 64 per call
Always pass bSilent=true (slow-task dialog exists in CreateProxyMesh path, not merge path)
Cooked-source materials bake unreliably — return materialBakeUnreliable warn field
